name: growth_session_seed
description: Foundations 6.3 [choice]: the file-local generator is seeded with derive(K) = S XOR K, moved by XOR 1 when it would be 0 or 0xFFFFFFFF; K is the original's clock XOR constant. Expected states from an independent Python model of derive(). Growth developers (K = 0xAC09C0E8, one generator shared by all of them): GrowthStatics::from_session gives 0x12345678 -> 0xBE3D9690 (an arbitrary session); 0x00000000 -> 0xAC09C0E8 (session 0 = the original's seed at clock value 0); 0xAC09C0E8 -> 0x00000001 (S = K: S XOR K = 0 is moved to 1); 0x53F63F17 -> 0xFFFFFFFE (S = NOT K: 0xFFFFFFFF is moved to 0xFFFFFFFE).
